migration_requirements: Apply existing WS07 migrations in order before 0003_public_account_api.sql.
Apply database/migrations/0003_public_account_api.sql before starting the WS13 production repository adapter.
Do not run WS13 with InMemoryAccountRepository in production.
delivery_requirements: Production verification/password-reset delivery requires the existing WS13 webhook delivery configuration.
OLDKO_ACCOUNT_DELIVERY_WEBHOOK_URL and OLDKO_ACCOUNT_DELIVERY_WEBHOOK_SECRET must be supplied through the deployment secret store; no secret values belong in this handoff.

website_runtime.opening_date: runtime-configurable and hidden by default; 2026-11-01 is not a release promise

verification.ws13_session_integration: PASS_2_OF_2: bad password 401; unauthenticated current-user 401; secure cookie login; authorized user+character read; logout revocation; post-logout 401; untrusted logout Origin 403
verification.password_hash_game_verifier_compatibilit: PASS: canonical WS13 hash verifies with the WS07 game-auth algorithm; wrong password rejected
verification.website_static_checks: PASS_4_OF_4 on production behavior invariants before source commit; committed source preserves the asserted canonical-domain/session-route/public-service invariants
verification.desktop_mobile_source_review: PASS_RESPONSIVE_SOURCE; rendered live-domain browser verification still required after WS09 deployment

ready_scope: Canonical root website source and account center are ready for WS09 static-host transfer.
Account frontend is wired to the real WS13 session/account contract and no longer opens #dashboard without server authorization.
WS13 and WS07 now provide the persistent shared-account source, migration, session persistence and game-compatible password format needed for production composition.
WS37 ranking and WS44 realm-status exact public contracts are wired; unavailable nation split is left blank rather than fabricated.

open_blockers.detail: WS09 currently has no authorized persistent host/stable public target, so static/backend transfer, DNS and TLS cutover cannot be completed.
Game auth/character production runtime must compose the asynchronous WS07 PostgreSQL adapter and pass the required immutable-child integration/browser gates.
Registration -> verification -> website login -> game login must still be exercised against one real composed PostgreSQL target before production compatibility is declared verified.
Current WS13 SecurityGate store is process-local; production requires a shared/durable limiter or an explicitly approved deployment-safe single-instance policy.
Verification/reset delivery webhook URL and secret must be supplied by the production secret store and smoke-tested without logging tokens.
admin.oldkoweb.com remains a separate deployment concern; its production persistent repository is not part of this website source commit.
Do not mark deployed until apex/play/admin TLS, HTTPS/WSS and real-domain browser account/game smoke tests pass.
